summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser's integration of WebRTC—**the technology behind video calls**—have focused on improving efficiency and reliability. This includes the implementation of retransmission stats for packet delivery, which helps in evaluating the quality of video streams. Additionally, Firefox will now maintain hardware support for decoding H.264 video when software options are unavailable, ensuring smoother playback. Other adjustments, such as preventing redundant data transmissions from inactive components and optimizing the handling of video data, contribute to a more streamlined experience for users relying on real-time communication. _These changes might not be immediately noticeable but are crucial for enhancing overall performance and reliability in video calls._
